name: Espresso - three stronger coffees
author: Anders
description: Adds Espresso (4 Coffee Beans), Double Espresso (5) and Triple Espresso (6), brewed at the Coffee Maker. Each gives a stronger movement speed boost than a Cup of Coffee for 24 hours: walk 4.85 for all three, run 5.3 / 5.5 / 5.7, bike 5.8 / 6.0 / 6.3. The items reuse blank item slots and the game's own Coffee state, so removing the mod leaves nothing broken behind. Edit the CONFIG block in js/plugins/Espresso.js.
